title: Presbyterian Church in America Historical Center
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: This project is designed to provide a convenient summary of the history of each of the paragraphs in the Book of Church Order of the Presbyterian Church in America. The primary point of this exercise is to show where we've come from and how we got here, to point out the value of the text we have inherited, and to perhaps help churchmen in their consideration of future changes in the Book of Church Order.
